question: Select the most appropriate option for blank 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"natural."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Natural"** means something that is inherent, innate, or in accordance with nature. (प्रकृति में विद्यमान, प्राकृतिक, मानव-प्रेरित या निर्मित नहीं; नैसर्गिक)

 
 
• **Example**: *I prefer to see animals in their **natural**__ habitat rather than in zoos.*
 
 
 
• In this context, the blank requires an adjective that describes the type of reasoning being used.
 
• **"Natural"** fits the context because it implies a type of reasoning that is intuitive and in line with common sense.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
 
• Correct passage:

Nainital has a __beautiful__ lake. Tourists come from far and wide to __enjoy__ boating here. There is a skating place behind it. People who skate here say that the ride seems to go round with them. Evenings are also pleasant here. The __reflection__ of the electric lights looks as if they are dancing in the ripples of the lake. Truly, Nainital is an __excellent__ city of __**natural**__ beauty.

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, "logical",** implies a type of reasoning that is based on strict rules and principles. (जो स्‍वाभाविक, युक्तिसंगत या तर्कयुक्त प्रतीत हो)
 
• **Option 3, "synthetic",** implies a type of reasoning that involves combining different ideas or concepts to form a new whole. (रासायनिक प्रक्रिया से निर्मित; कृत्रिम)
 
• **Option 4, "chronic", **doesn't fit the context at all because it means something that is long-lasting or persistent, and isn't related to reasoning. ((रोग या समस्‍या) पुरानी, चिरकालिक, दीर्घकालिक)
